+def _temporal_routes(data):
+    required = data.get("required", [])
+    bit = {node: 1 << i for i, node in enumerate(required)}
+    full = (1 << len(required)) - 1
+    graph = [[] for _ in range(data["n"])]
+    for edge in data["edges"]:
+        graph[edge["u"]].append(edge)
+    source = data["source"]
+    start = data["start"]
+    initial_mask = bit.get(source, 0)
+    initial = (source, initial_mask, data["coupons"])
+    distances = {initial: start}
+    queue = [(start, source, initial_mask, data["coupons"])]
+    while queue:
+        time, node, mask, remaining = heapq.heappop(queue)
+        state = (node, mask, remaining)
+        if distances.get(state) != time:
+            continue
+        if node == data["target"] and mask == full:
+            return {"arrival": time}
+        for edge in graph[node]:
+            depart = max(time, edge["open"])
+            if depart >= edge["close"]:
+                continue
+            options = [(edge["duration"], remaining)]
+            if remaining:
+                duration = max(2, edge["duration"] - edge.get("discount", 0))
+                options.append((duration, remaining - 1))
+            for duration, next_remaining in options:
+                arrival = depart + duration
+                if arrival > data["deadline"]:
+                    continue
+                next_node = edge["v"]
+                next_mask = mask | bit.get(next_node, 0)
+                next_state = (next_node, next_mask, next_remaining)
+                if arrival < distances.get(next_state, float("inf")):
+                    distances[next_state] = arrival
+                    heapq.heappush(queue, (arrival, next_node, next_mask, next_remaining))
